newsitem.title: USA: Canada spot LPGs slightly down, trade quiet.
newsitem.headline: Canada spot LPGs slightly down, trade quiet.

text.p: Spot prices of Canada liquids started off the month slightly lower although the market was difficult to gauge, traders said, due to a lack of activity in the week.
Butane prices were expected to drop significantly later this week amid an anticipated four cent reduction in postings in the Edmonton, Canaada, hub from last month.
In Edmonton, field butane was unchanged from last Thursday at between 30.00 cents and 31.00 cents a gallon.
Sarnia normal butane was slightly down, about a half cent for sellers, at 35.00/35.50 cents.
Sarnia isobutane was pegged 41.00/41.75 cents, traders said.
"It's been very light this week," said an Edmonton trader, noting a lack of demand.
"Butane is the only commodity that may be moving because it's a posting day and we're expecting them to drop four cents from last month," he added.
